profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website, claude.ai, presents Claude as Anthropic's AI, described as built for problem solvers and aimed at tackling complex challenges, analyzing data, writing code, and working through difficult problems.

The company's listed products include Claude, a general LLM assistant; Anthropic Console, an API management console with prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls; Claude Code, an agentic coding tool with source-code exposure; and Computer Use, a computer control agent for desktop automation with high-privilege operation risk. A Model Context Protocol server named ai.getvda/llm-orchestration-agent-langchain-anthropic is associated with the company.

Court records list multiple cases involving Anthropic PBC across federal district and appellate courts, including Sony Music Publishing (US) LLC v. Anthropic PBC, Round Hill Music LP v. Anthropic PBC, University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC, and several individual plaintiff suits in California, Vermont, Hawaii, and Delaware. The company's legal exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 associated matters.
